summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Huachen AI Parking Management Technology Holding Co., Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders held on July 8, 2026. Shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital from US$78,125 to US$37,500,000 and authorized the board to implement one or more share consolidations at ratios up to 4000:1 over two years. This is a routine corporate action related to capital structure and does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. The event is administrative in nature with no change in control or strategic repositioning.
